tools.name: search_agent_automations
tools.description: Search 819 agent automation prompts by keyword. Returns matching automations with title, description, complexity and services. Costs $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: get_agent_automation
tools.description: Get the full agent automation prompt and workflow steps by slug. Costs $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: list_automation_categories
tools.description: List all 35 automation categories with counts. Costs $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: get_crypto_signals
tools.description: Latest Kronos model context for BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA. Directional values are supporting context, not standalone trade instructions; use them with the calibrated range, risk state, and audit record. Costs $0.05 USDC.

affiliate_id.description: Optional Pyrimid affiliate ID (af_xxxxx). Affiliate earns a commission from within the listed price — no extra cost to you.

tools.name: get_crypto_risk
tools.description: Current market risk state and cooldown context for Kronos decisions. Useful as supporting context, not a standalone trading command. Costs $0.02 USDC.

tools.name: get_crypto_signal_history
tools.description: Recent Kronos context history for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/ADA. Use it to inspect model context and freshness before or after a decision. Costs $0.05 USDC.

hours.description: Hours of history to fetch (default 24, max 168)

affiliate_id.description: Optional Pyrimid affiliate ID (af_xxxxx). Affiliate earns a commission from within the listed price — no extra cost to you.

tools.name: get_crypto_decision
tools.description: Create a market-intelligence journal entry from Kronos context. Returns directional_bias, confidence context, compliance metadata, regime, anomaly/calibration context, and a decision_id. Call audit_trade_decision with that ID after the evaluation window to see what happened. Costs $0.15 USDC.

symbol.description: Symbol to evaluate: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, or ADA

affiliate_id.description: Optional Pyrimid affiliate ID (af_xxxxx). Affiliate earns a commission from within the listed price — no extra cost to you.

tools.name: check_trade_preflight
tools.description: Step 1 of the auditable decision loop. Checks market state, cooldown, data freshness, and model context before calling get_crypto_decision. Costs $0.05 USDC.

symbol.description: Symbol to check: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, or ADA

affiliate_id.description: Optional Pyrimid affiliate ID (af_xxxxx). Affiliate earns a commission from within the listed price — no extra cost to you.

tools.name: audit_trade_decision
tools.description: The accountability step. Verify a Kronos decision_id against later market prices. Returns whether direction held, PnL%, and a verdict: GOOD_DECISION, BAD_DIRECTION, NOISE, or NO_ACTION_TAKEN. Costs $0.07 USDC.

decision_id.description: UUID from a previous get_crypto_decision call

affiliate_id.description: Optional Pyrimid affiliate ID (af_xxxxx). Affiliate earns a commission from within the listed price — no extra cost to you.

tools.name: get_futures_decision
tools.description: Kronos Futures: perpetual-futures decision package. Direction LONG / SHORT / FLAT from the Kronos signal, stop-loss and take-profit on the calibrated 80% range, leverage cap keeping liquidation outside 2x the stop, liquidation price, risk-based position size for your equity, and live perp funding cost. Market intelligence only; no exchange execution. Costs $0.15 USDC.

symbol.description: Symbol: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA (default: BTC)

equity.description: Account equity in USD for position sizing (optional)

max_loss_pct.description: Max loss per position as a fraction of equity (default 0.01)

tools.name: get_perp_funding
tools.description: Kronos Futures: live perpetual funding rates (1h, 8h, annualized), mark/index price, open interest, and crowding label (LONG_CROWDED / SHORT_CROWDED / BALANCED) for BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA from Kraken Futures and Hyperliquid. Costs $0.02 USDC.

symbol.description: Optional single symbol; omit for all five

tools.name: check_futures_risk
tools.description: Kronos Futures: will a leveraged perp position survive the calibrated range? Returns liquidation price and distance, adverse range bound, verdict (SURVIVES_RANGE / THIN_BUFFER / LIQUIDATION_INSIDE_RANGE), max surviving leverage, P&L at both range bounds, and funding cost. Costs $0.05 USDC.

symbol.description: Symbol: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA (default: BTC)

entry.description: Entry price (defaults to current perp mark)

notional.description: Position notional in USD for funding cost (optional)

tools.name: get_crypto_forecast
tools.description: Conformally-calibrated price forecast: an honest 80% prediction interval (range_80, ~0.80 empirical coverage) plus point return and upside probability for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/ADA. Directional bias is supporting context; the calibrated range is the validated product. Costs $0.05 USDC.

symbol.description: Symbol: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA (default: BTC)

affiliate_id.description: Optional Pyrimid affiliate ID (af_xxxxx). Affiliate earns a commission from within the listed price — no extra cost to you.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Free. Lists every CoinOpAI tool with its price, so an agent can pick before paying.

tools.name: review_signal_anomaly
tools.description: Score a market signal feature set for unusual conditions before downstream analysis. Returns anomaly_score, anomaly_level, review_label, drivers, component scores, and market-intelligence disclaimers. Not financial advice and not a market activity instruction. Costs $0.07 USDC.

symbol.description: Symbol to review, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, AAPL, SPY

features.description: Numeric feature values to score, such as price_change, volume_change, volatility, signal_confidence, risk_score, social_velocity, or onchain_velocity.
